title: Import contacts
prompt: Import this customer list and show me duplicates.
note: An import previews new and changed values for each row. Empty cells can clear existing values; the preview makes this visible.

title: Maintain customer knowledge
prompt: Update this contact and add our conversation note.
note: Contacts and notes remain linked to the company and deal. Missing values are not invented.

title: Develop deals
prompt: Move the Relaunch deal to Proposal and record its amount.
note: Kanban cards are updated through the agent. The browser view remains read-only.

title: Assess the pipeline
prompt: What is the value of our weighted pipeline?
note: This workflow reads data. It does not change deals or require write approval. Weights are saved only with separate approval.

title: Plan next steps
prompt: Create a task to follow up on the proposal.
note: The deadline and assignee are clarified. There is no background notification service.

title: Prepare onboarding
prompt: When a deal is won, prepare an onboarding task and welcome email.
note: After approved activation, matching events are processed on the next invocation. The welcome email remains a draft.

title: Link messages
prompt: Assign these exported messages to our contacts.
note: Detected credentials are redacted. New contacts require approval; message attachments are recorded as metadata.

title: Organize events
prompt: Import this calendar export and match the events.
note: Existing events are imported from a file. There is no calendar booking or invitation sending.

title: Prepare campaigns
prompt: Prepare personalized drafts for this approved list.
note: Recipients without consent and suppressed addresses are excluded. The CRM generates drafts and sends nothing.

title: Analyze and export
prompt: Show this week's deals and export the approved selection.
note: Analysis uses verified data. The export is written outside the workspace and identifies included personal data.

title: Merge duplicates
prompt: Merge these duplicate companies and show me their differences.
note: You choose the surviving record and valid values. Merging destroys the other records and requires explicit approval.

title: Attach proposals
prompt: Attach this proposal PDF to the appropriate company.
note: Files up to 25 MB are copied after a verified plan. Larger files remain external links; binary files are not inspected for credentials in their contents.

title: Undo an import
prompt: Undo this import and show me what will change.
note: A revert may permanently remove newly created records. Later changes are reported; the consequences require explicit approval. Privacy erasure cannot be undone.

title: Remove personal data
prompt: Remove this contact's personal data after reviewing the erasure preview.
note: The preview covers records, history, affected attachments and drafts. Name mentions in knowledge and sources need their own procedures. External backups and exports are not reached.

title: Add custom fields
prompt: Add a contract duration field to our companies.
note: Custom objects and fields are added through a validated plan. Dependent views, dashboards and workflows are considered before the change.

title: Follow up stalled deals
prompt: Find deals without progress and prepare follow-up tasks.
note: First, the verified state is analyzed. Tasks are created only after an agreed selection and preview. A recurring workflow runs on the next invocation, not in the background.
